items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Can you remember any more about that Friars Inn band, you know, and Paul Merez and Paul Hogan?

ctx.x: Yeah. Can you remember any more about that Friars Inn band, you know, and Paul Merez and Paul Hogan? Can you tell us a little more about that?

That was a real good band. You had to hear that band in person. Yeah. Because the records, the time they made records, and I made records for Jeanette the same way, you had to record through a horn, you know.
